narrative.overview: The interface feels like a dark technical field becoming legible under examination. Theatre always resolves into evidence, and mobile is recomposed as a compact evidence index rather than a stacked desktop page.
keyCharacteristics: Strong scale contrast and thin rules
Motion that communicates resolution or state

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal lime appears only on focus, selection, a meaningful node, or verified state.

rules.name: The One Serif Move Rule
rules.body: Serif type marks interpretation or reflection and cannot become the default heading treatment for every block.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Evidence sits on the same plane as the story and is separated by alignment, spacing, and one-pixel rules.

dos: Do show ownership before project entry.
Do use real media or clearly labeled source-backed diagrams.
Do keep claims aligned with the claims ledger.
donts: Don't use generic gradient blobs or decorative grid overlays.
Don't imply sole ownership or invent outcomes.
